complex_event_id.description: Reference to the complex event this check-in belongs to

booking_id.description: Reference to the complex_event_booking being checked in

session_id.description: Reference to the complex_event_session being checked in

checked_in_at.description: When the attendee was checked in. Null when never checked in or when a check-in has been reversed (deregistered).

checked_in_by.description: Label of who performed the check-in

check_in_reversed_by.description: Label of who reversed the check-in

check_in_reversal_reason.description: Optional reason a check-in was reversed
